audit: erun outputs download --dry-run report.pdf
outputs: downloading <HOME>/.erun/outputs/report.pdf
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
outputs probe script:
  target='<HOME>/.erun/outputs/report.pdf'
  if [ -d "$target" ]; then
    staged=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/erun-outputs-XXXXXX") || { echo "erun-outputs: cannot stage an archive of $target" >&2; exit 5; }
    if ! tar czf "$staged" --exclude=/dev --exclude=/proc --exclude=/sys -C '<HOME>/.erun/outputs' 'report.pdf'; then
      rm -f "$staged"
      echo "erun-outputs: cannot archive $target" >&2
      exit 5
    fi
    kind=dir
  elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
    staged="$target"
    kind=file
  else
    echo "erun-outputs: not found: $target" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
  size=$(wc -c < "$staged" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$size" -gt 104857600 ]; then
    if [ "$kind" = dir ]; then rm -f "$staged"; fi
    echo "erun-outputs: $target exceeds the 104857600 byte limit ($size bytes)" >&2
    exit 4
  fi
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    digest=$(sha256sum "$staged" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  elif command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    digest=$(openssl dgst -sha256 "$staged" | sed 's/.*[ =]//')
  else
    digest=
  fi
  printf '%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n' "$kind" "$size" "$staged" "$digest"
  if command -v gzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'gzip\n'
    tail -c +1 "$staged" | head -c 8388608 | gzip -1 | base64
  else
    printf 'raw\n'
    tail -c +1 "$staged" | head -c 8388608 | base64
  fi
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
outputs range script:
  if command -v gzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'gzip\n'
    tail -c +1 '<HOME>/.erun/outputs/report.pdf' | head -c 8388608 | gzip -1 | base64
  else
    printf 'raw\n'
    tail -c +1 '<HOME>/.erun/outputs/report.pdf' | head -c 8388608 | base64
  fi
